proves.claim: with 300 writes already pending in one queue directory, each newly published write takes a sequence number above every visible record and the 300 writes apply in publish order, and the case prints the milliseconds spent in the publish, drain and waiter-settle steps.

store.io-write-queue-file.publish-order-.why: Without it a publish that stopped taking its number from the high-water record could reuse a number below a visible record, or go back to reading every pending record under the lock, and nothing would show it.
